svg.title: The shopkeeper's "What can I get you?"
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn picture. A corner-shop counter with the shopkeeper in a green T-shirt behind it and coloured jars on the shelf at the back. A small sign hanging over the counter reads PAT:. The shopkeeper's bubble says "What can I get you?". On the left a customer in a blue T-shirt holds a slip of paper. A label "monitor program" points to the shopkeeper and "command" to the slip.
